notablePrerequisites:
You have at least two opponents.
Auton Soldier does not have summoning sickness.
Captain's Claws attached to a creature that does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Declare Auton Soldier and the creature with Captain's Claws as attackers.
Auton Soldier's myriad ability and Captain's Claws trigger.
Resolve the Auton Soldier trigger, creating nine token copies of itself as a nonlegendary copy of Ojer Taq attacking each other opponent.
Resolve the Captain's Claws trigger, creating 3^(the number of Ojer Taqs you control) 1/1 Kor Ally creature tokens tapped and attacking an opponent.

Auton Soldier
uses.cardState: as a copy of Ojer Taq
